roots.label: Live Overlay Lab
roots.description: Start live overlay, or tune the LCO console before/while you use it.

children.label: Toggle Console (OFF)
children.description: Remembered on/off preference. Window follows Live Overlay sessions.

children.label: Console Verbosity (results)
children.description: Cycle events → results → process. Only while console is ON.

roots.label: Molecule Lab
roots.description: Compose molecules or author atoms on Deck.

children.label: Atom Lab
children.description: Lightweight Molecule Lab focused on the Atom tab (library + LOL coverage).

children.label: Create Atom
children.description: Atom Create on Deck — queue + drag-place. Esc saves and returns to Atom Lab.

roots.label: Observation Lab
roots.description: Observation Lab entry float — full panes in Idle Lab. Mark cut.

roots.label: Idle Lab
roots.description: Exclusive mouse surface — closes Flight Deck.

children.label: Start (closes Flight Deck)
children.description: Hide Flight Deck and open Idle Lab. Surfaces never share the screen.

roots.label: Settings
roots.description: Common Deck settings inline; full panel still available.

children.label: Open Settings
children.description: Open the Settings float (boot + Activate key).

children.label: Boot Preferences (Idle Lab)
children.description: Cycle boot surface: Idle Lab ↔ Flight Deck (applies on Restart).
